# engineering

Backend and app engineering playbooks: React Native with Expo (server state, client state, over-the-air release)

Claude Code: included in the `rumblejack-skills` plugin, so skills are invoked as `/rumblejack-skills:<skill>`.

Just this bucket:

```bash
npx skills add https://github.com/RumbleJack56/skills/tree/main/skills/engineering
```

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`client-state-setup`](client-state-setup/SKILL.md) | Sets up client state in an Expo React Native app with Zustand. |
| [`ota-playbook`](ota-playbook/SKILL.md) | Sets up and runs releases for an Expo React Native app: EAS Update, runtime version, channels, rollouts, rollbacks and a server-enforced minimum app version (HTTP 426). |
| [`server-api-setup`](server-api-setup/SKILL.md) | Sets up server state in an Expo React Native app with Supabase, Zod and TanStack Query: feature modules (schema, api, queries, mutations), query keys, stale times, invalidation, Realtime and the auth session. |
